commentary.text: 90+1' That's it for today, Ricardo De Burgos has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the right post.
90' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Madrid.
86' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
86' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) picks up an injury.
85' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
84' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. Oviedo win a corner.
84' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.

80' 2 - 0 Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Aaron Escandell had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
80' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the left side of the goal that is easily dealt with by Aaron Escandell.
79' It will be a substitution. Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) is ready to enter the pitch as Nacho Vidal walks off.
79' The game has come to an end for Nicolas Fonseca. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pablo Agudin (Real Oviedo).
77' Here is a change. Franco Mastantuono is going off and Alvaro Arbeloa gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Yanez (Real Madrid).
77' Here's the change. Brahim Diaz leaves the pitch and Cesar Palacios (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
76' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
76' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
74' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) is penalised for holding. Ricardo De Burgos signals a set piece. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
71' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
70' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gonzalo Garcia leaves the pitch and Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) comes on.
69' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) replacing Thiago Fernandez.
67' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
64' Alvaro Arbeloa has decided to make a change. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) replaces Aurelien Tchouameni.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Trent Alexander-Arnold departs the field of play to be replaced by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid).
63' Golden opportunity! Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
62' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
58' Aaron Escandell pulls off a great save to deny Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
57' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way wide of the right-hand post.
54' Substitution. Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) replaces Ilyas Chaira.
54' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His low drive to the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by Aaron Escandell.
53' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) was too forceful with his tackle and Ricardo De Burgos interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Real Madrid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
51' Close! Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
50' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
49' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
46' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The referee signals a corner kick to Oviedo.
46' The attendance is 62774.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

44' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid). Brahim Diaz plays a fantastic through ball and finds Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
42' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
40' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) swings it in and Aurelien Tchouameni gets on the end of it, but Aaron Escandell shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
38' What a big chance! Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
35' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
33' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt.
31' Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
28' Ricardo De Burgos interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid). Oviedo have a free kick.
25' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
24' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Aaron Escandell.
21' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
21' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.
21' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
18' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
16' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
12' An attempted cross from Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) is cleared.
9' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) takes it short.
9' Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. Now Oviedo have a corner.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo). Oviedo force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
8' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
8' Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play. Oviedo win a corner kick.

6' Aaron Escandell pulls off a great save to deny Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
2' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared.

2' He should have scored! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Aaron Escandell sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top left corner.
The players are on the pitch and Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
